text:
Lizzy: quick sync on the suppression modal and channel preview UX. ran into a couple keyboard and copy issues while testing :thinking_face: Omar: can you list repro steps? browser / platform? Lizzy: mac + chrome. Open alert -> Edit suppression -> Tab into channel selector -> pick a channel -> focus goes behind modal (page body). Patrick: sounds like we lost a focus-trap around the channel list. modal should trap focus and return it to the triggering element on close. Sam: another keyboard bug: pressing Enter while navigating channel suggestions closes the modal instead of selecting the item. Expected: Enter selects suggestion; Esc closes modal. Maya: rule of thumb: Enter should only submit when a primary button is focused or the control explicitly handles submit. agree we should change handler. a11y-bot: Scan result: missing role="dialog" and aria-modal attributes on suppression modal. Also focus not set to first focusable element on open in 7% of tests. Lizzy: noted. Also noticed channel chips in compact mode have poor contrast when selected (measured ~2.6:1). Fails AA for small text. Omar: compact chips were used to save vertical space, but modal already constrains height. Could we use full pills inside the modal and keep compact in the matrix view? Maya: that would help visuals + hit area. I'll update mocks to show full pills in modal and keep compact elsewhere. Patrick: accessibility nit: the suppression summary that updates after schedule change needs aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce the update. Sam: quick HTML we can add: ```html
Suppression scheduled: Mon 9:00 UTC
``` Lizzy: small copy thing: labels "Start time" / "End time" are ambiguous about timezone. Users thought it was UTC. Proposal: show user-local timezone next to times and add a "Change timezone" link. Omar: prefer adding an inline link rather than bloating labels. Also suggest the preview header should read "Preview notifications" not "Preview channels" to clarify intent. Maya: agreed, and propose an inline compact preview (max 3 items + "+N more") to keep modal height under control. Clicking "+N more" opens full preview panel. Patrick: tooltip idea for the channels column: keep header short "Channels" and add a focusable help icon with tooltip "Destinations for notifications; choose routing and filters." Make tooltip keyboard accessible. Sam: implementation note: avoid adding tabindex="0" to non-interactive containers. That causes extra tab stops. Only interactive elements should be focusable. Lizzy: accessibility checklist to implement: 1) role="dialog" + aria-modal on modal 2) focus trap + set focus to first control on open and return on close 3) ensure Enter selects items, not closes modal 4) fix chip contrast or add strong border/weight 5) add aria-live suppression summary 6) change preview wording and add inline pill preview 7) make tooltip focusable and keyboard operable Omar: I'll iterate on header tooltip copy and the timezone link behavior. Maya: I'll push updated mocks and microcopy (including contrast spec) by EOD. Sam: I'll take the keyboard behavior fixes and add unit/e2e tests for focus and Enter handling. Patrick: dev note: when implementing pill styles, include a higher-contrast selected state and a focus-visible outline for keyboard users. Lizzy: thanks all, will upload updated design files once Maya's mock is done. leaving thread open for follow-ups :thumbsup:
